series.name: Sharp PSR outdoor PCB LED1 blink counts
series.notes: Outdoor power-supply PCB indicator read as blink count n (bright 0.5s, dark 0.5s, n flashes, then dark 3s). Source table lists n = 1-21, 23-28, 30-33; counts 22 and 29 are absent from the manual. Page text extracts mirrored, so row pairings were re-read carefully.

meaning.en: Outdoor LED blinks once for normal defrost, not a failure.
meaning.ur: Outdoor LED normal defrost ke liye ek baar blink karta hai, yeh fault nahi.

causes.en: Normal defrost cycle during heating.
causes.ur: Heating ke dauran normal defrost cycle.

causes.en: Coil frost build-up triggered the cycle.
causes.ur: Coil par barf jamne se cycle chalu hui.

solutions.en: No repair needed, wait for the cycle to end.
solutions.ur: Koi repair nahi, cycle khatam hone dein.

solutions.en: If defrost never ends, check sensors and the 4-way valve.
solutions.ur: Defrost kabhi khatam na ho to sensors aur 4-way valve check karein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

title.ur: Intake temperature sensor short ya open

meaning.en: Outdoor intake temperature sensor circuit is shorted or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor intake temperature sensor ki line short ya open hai.

causes.en: Sensor wire damaged or connector loose.
causes.ur: Sensor wire kharab ya connector dheela hai.

causes.en: Thermistor failed.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the sensor.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur sensor naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the intake temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Intake temperature sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: Over current was detected on the outdoor board.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board par over current detect hua.

causes.en: Outdoor fan or compressor drawing high current.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan ya compressor zyada current le raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor power board fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor power board kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check airflow and fan motor, then measure running amps.
solutions.ur: Hawa aur fan motor check karke running ampere naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if amps are normal.
solutions.ur: Ampere normal ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: Discharge/exhaust temperature exceeded the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Discharge/exhaust temperature protection limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage or blocked airflow.
causes.ur: Gas kam ya hawa block hai.

causes.en: Exhaust temperature sensor drifted or open.
causes.ur: Exhaust temperature sensor drift ya open ho gaya.

solutions.en: Clear outdoor airflow and charge refrigerant if short.
solutions.ur: Outdoor ki hawa kholein aur gas kam ho to bharayein.

solutions.en: Replace the exhaust temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Exhaust temperature sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: Outdoor coil temperature went above the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ka temperature protection limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Dirty or blocked outdoor coil.
causes.ur: Outdoor coil ganda ya block hai.

causes.en: Coil temperature sensor fault.
causes.ur: Coil temperature sensor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Wash the outdoor coil and clear the fan area.
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil dhoyein aur fan ka raasta kholein.

solutions.en: Replace the coil temperature sensor if reading is off.
solutions.ur: Reading ghalat ho to coil temperature sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The inverter drive protection tripped.
meaning.ur: Inverter drive protection trip ho gayi.

causes.en: IPM or power stage fault.
causes.ur: IPM ya power stage kharab hai.

causes.en: Compressor winding problem.
causes.ur: Compressor winding mein masla hai.

solutions.en: Check compressor windings and IPM for shorts.
solutions.ur: Compressor windings aur IPM ka short check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the IPM or outdoor power board as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabik IPM ya outdoor power board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

title.ur: Indoor unit ke sath communication fault

meaning.en: The outdoor board is not receiving data from the indoor unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ko indoor unit se data nahi mil raha.

causes.en: Inter-unit wiring loose or crossed.
causes.ur: Inter-unit wire dheeli ya ulta lag gayi.

causes.en: Indoor board not transmitting.
causes.ur: Indoor board transmit nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Check inter-unit wiring and terminal L/N correspondence.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring aur L/N mapping check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the faulty indoor or outdoor board.
solutions.ur: Kharab indoor ya outdoor board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The compressor top temperature switch opened from overheating.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke upar wala temperature switch garmi se khul gaya.

causes.en: Low gas or blocked outdoor ventilation.
causes.ur: Gas kam ya outdoor ki hawa block hai.

causes.en: Top switch itself is faulty.
causes.ur: Upar wala switch hi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check system pressure and add refrigerant if low.
solutions.ur: System pressure check karein, kam ho to gas bharayein.

solutions.en: Clear outdoor ventilation and replace the top switch if it trips again.
solutions.ur: Outdoor ki hawa kholein, phir trip ho to top switch badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

title.ur: Outdoor temperature sensor short ya open

meaning.en: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor line is shorted or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor ki line short ya open hai.

causes.en: Sensor wire broken or connector loose.
causes.ur: Sensor wire toot gayi ya connector dheela hai.

causes.en: Thermistor failed.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the sensor.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur sensor naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor temperature sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

title.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger sensor short ya open

meaning.en: Outdoor heat-exchanger temperature sensor is shorted or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger temperature sensor short ya open hai.

causes.en: Sensor plug loose or wire damaged.
causes.ur: Sensor ka plug dheela ya wire kharab hai.

causes.en: Thermistor failed.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the sensor.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur sensor naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor heat exchanger sensor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

title.ur: Discharge temperature sensor short ya open

meaning.en: Compressor discharge temperature sensor is shorted or open.
meaning.ur: Compressor discharge temperature sensor short ya open hai.

causes.en: Sensor wire damaged at the discharge pipe.
causes.ur: Discharge pipe par sensor wire kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: Thermistor failed.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the sensor (25C / 20k).
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur sensor naapein (25C / 20k).

solutions.en: Replace the discharge temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Discharge temperature sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The outdoor voltage sensing circuit is not reading the mains.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ka voltage sensing circuit mains nahi padh raha.

causes.en: Voltage sampling circuit on the outdoor board has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor board ka voltage sampling circuit fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Supply outside the unit's range.
causes.ur: Supply unit ki range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the mains is within the unit's rating.
solutions.ur: Mains unit ki rating ke andar hai, confirm karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board.
solutions.ur: Outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The board's current sensor is not reading compressor current.
meaning.ur: Board ka current sensor compressor ka current nahi padh raha.

causes.en: Current sensor on the outdoor board has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor board ka current sensor fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak causing abnormal current.
causes.ur: Gas leak se current abnormal ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check for leaks and repair them.
solutions.ur: Leak check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if there is no leak.
solutions.ur: Leak na ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The intelligent power module reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Intelligent power module ne fault diya hai

causes.en: IPM shorted or not mounted on the heat sink properly.
causes.ur: IPM short hai ya heat sink par theek se nahi laga.

causes.en: Compressor wiring fault.
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit the IPM with even screws and fresh silicone.
solutions.ur: IPM ko barabar screw aur nayi silicone ke sath lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the IPM if it tests shorted.
solutions.ur: Short nikle to IPM badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

title.en: Communication fault power board to IPM
title.ur: Power board aur IPM ka communication fault

meaning.en: The power source board and the IPM are not exchanging signals.
meaning.ur: Power source board aur IPM aapas mein signal nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: Communication wire between the boards is loose.
causes.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan communication wire dheeli hai.

causes.en: IPM or power source board has failed.
causes.ur: IPM ya power source board fail ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Refit the communication wire and compare both board indicators.
solutions.ur: Communication wire wapas lagayein aur dono board ke indicators compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the board whose indicator stays dead.
solutions.ur: Jiska indicator band rahe us board ko badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

title.en: No feedback from outdoor DC fan motor
title.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor ka feedback nahi

meaning.en: The outdoor DC fan motor gave no speed feedback.
meaning.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor ne koi speed feedback nahi diya.

causes.en: Fan motor failed or connector is loose.
causes.ur: Fan motor fail ho gaya ya connector dheela hai.

causes.en: Fan drive circuit on the board is faulty.
causes.ur: Board ka fan drive circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check the fan blade and connector.
solutions.ur: Power band karke fan blade aur connector check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: IPM protection operated on the outdoor module.
meaning.ur: Outdoor module par IPM protection chal gayi.

causes.en: Over current or over temperature at the module.
causes.ur: Module par over current ya over temperature.

causes.en: IPM or compressor problem.
causes.ur: IPM ya compressor ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Check compressor wiring and system pressure.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki wiring aur system pressure check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the IPM if the protection repeats.
solutions.ur: Protection dohraye to IPM badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: Supply voltage went above or below the allowed window.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage allowed window se upar ya neeche chala gaya.

causes.en: Local mains sag or surge.
causes.ur: Local mains ka girna ya surge.

causes.en: Voltage sensing fault on the board.
causes.ur: Board par voltage sensing kharab hai.

solutions.en: Measure the supply and fit a protector if unstable.
solutions.ur: Supply naapein, unstable ho to protector lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Supply normal ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The outdoor board's EEPROM could not be read.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ka EEPROM padha nahi ja saka.

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Data lost after a power disturbance.
causes.ur: Power disturbance ke baad data kho gaya.

solutions.en: Power cycle once from the breaker.
solutions.ur: Breaker se ek baar power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board.
solutions.ur: Outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: Protection operated on the outdoor fan motor.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor par protection chal gayi.

causes.en: Fan motor overheated or is jammed.
causes.ur: Fan motor overheat hua ya atak gaya.

causes.en: Fan capacitor or drive fault.
causes.ur: Fan capacitor ya drive kharab hai.

solutions.en: Free the fan blade and check the capacitor.
solutions.ur: Fan blade azaad karein aur capacitor check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: Protection operated on the indoor fan motor, reported through the outdoor LED.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor par protection chal gayi, outdoor LED se report hui.

causes.en: Indoor fan jammed or overloaded.
causes.ur: Indoor fan atka hua ya overload hai.

causes.en: Indoor board or motor fault.
causes.ur: Indoor board ya motor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check the cross-flow blade and motor connector indoors.
solutions.ur: Indoor ja kar cross-flow blade aur motor connector check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor fan motor if it does not run freely.
solutions.ur: Fan motor freely na chale to badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The system judged that refrigerant is short.
meaning.ur: System ne faisla kiya ke gas kam hai.

causes.en: Leak in the piping or joints.
causes.ur: Piping ya joints mein leak hai.

causes.en: Charge was never completed after installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad murawwat mukammal nahi hui.

solutions.en: Leak test, repair the leak, then vacuum and charge to spec.
solutions.ur: Leak test karein, leak theek karein, phir vacuum karke spec hisab se gas bharayein.

solutions.en: Recheck the pressure after charging.
solutions.ur: Gas bharne ke baad pressure dobara check karein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The board's model configuration does not match the unit.
meaning.ur: Board ki model configuration unit se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Model jumper or setting is wrong.
causes.ur: Model jumper ya setting ghalat hai.

causes.en: Board swapped without reconfiguring.
causes.ur: Board bina reconfigure kiye hi badal diya gaya

solutions.en: Check model jumpers against the nameplate.
solutions.ur: Model jumpers ko nameplate se milayein.

solutions.en: Reconfigure or replace the board.
solutions.ur: Board dobara configure karein ya badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: An indoor room temperature sensor is out of range.
meaning.ur: Indoor room temperature sensor range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or sensor failed.
causes.ur: Sensor connector dheela ya sensor kharab hai.

causes.en: Wiring to the indoor sensor is damaged.
causes.ur: Indoor sensor tak ki wire kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the sensor.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur sensor naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor room sensor.
solutions.ur: Indoor room sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The indoor coil temperature sensor is out of range.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil temperature sensor range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or sensor failed.
causes.ur: Sensor connector dheela ya sensor kharab hai.

causes.en: Sensor not clamped on the coil pipe.
causes.ur: Sensor coil pipe par kada nahi laga.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and clamp the sensor on the pipe.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur sensor pipe par kas kar lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor coil sensor.
solutions.ur: Indoor coil sensor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The indoor board's EEPROM could not be read.
meaning.ur: Indoor board ka EEPROM padha nahi ja saka.

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Data lost after a power cut.
causes.ur: Power cut ke baad data kho gaya.

solutions.en: Power cycle once from the breaker.
solutions.ur: Breaker se ek baar power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor main PCB.
solutions.ur: Indoor main PCB badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor is not running correctly.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor theek se nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Cross-flow blade blocked or motor locked.
causes.ur: Cross-flow blade block ya motor lock hai.

causes.en: Motor connector or capacitor fault.
causes.ur: Motor connector ya capacitor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Free the blade and refit the motor connector.
solutions.ur: Blade azaad karein aur motor connector wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor fan motor.
solutions.ur: Indoor fan motor badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The outdoor inverter drive reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Outdoor inverter drive ne fault diya hai

causes.en: IPM or gate drive stage failure.
causes.ur: IPM ya gate drive stage fail ho gayi.

causes.en: Compressor winding short or open.
causes.ur: Compressor winding short ya open hai.

solutions.en: Test the IPM and compressor windings.
solutions.ur: IPM aur compressor windings test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power board or IPM as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabik outdoor power board ya IPM badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: Outside temperature is beyond the permitted operating band.
meaning.ur: Bahar ka temperature allowed operating band se bahar hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature genuinely outside the range.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature waqai range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Outdoor intake sensor drifted or open.
causes.ur: Outdoor intake sensor drift ya open ho gaya.

solutions.en: If the weather is outside the range, wait for it to recover.
solutions.ur: Mausam range se bahar ho to behtar hone ka intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Measure and replace the outdoor intake sensor if faulty.
solutions.ur: Outdoor intake sensor naapein, kharab ho to badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The unit is holding back to stop the indoor coil from freezing.
meaning.ur: Unit indoor coil ko barf jamne se rokne ke liye ruk gayi hai.

causes.en: Low airflow across the indoor coil.
causes.ur: Indoor coil par hawa kamzor hai.

causes.en: Dirty filter or indoor coil.
causes.ur: Filter ya indoor coil ganda hai.

solutions.en: Clean the filter and indoor coil.
solutions.ur: Filter aur indoor coil saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the indoor fan speed and motor.
solutions.ur: Indoor ki fan speed aur motor check karein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB

meaning.en: The indoor coil ran too hot and protection stopped the run.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil bohat garam ho gaya, protection ne run rok diya.

causes.en: Blocked indoor airflow or dirty coil.
causes.ur: Indoor ki hawa block hai ya coil ganda hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant overcharge or expansion valve problem.
causes.ur: Gas zyada charge hai ya expansion valve ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Clean the filter and indoor coil, then restart.
solutions.ur: Filter aur indoor coil saaf karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the expansion valve and refrigerant charge.
solutions.ur: Expansion valve aur gas charge check karein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart — outdoor power supply PCB
